name: MK19.9 Test Connection on the cloud metadata address shows moke's refusal and its reason
js: await (async()=>{const u=document.getElementById('conn-url');u.value='https://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/';u.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true}));document.getElementById('btn-test').click();for(let i=0;i<50;i++){const b=document.getElementById('resp-body-body').textContent;if(/refused by moke’s proxy \(403\).*cloud metadata/.test(b))return document.getElementById('btn-load-dataset').disabled===true;await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,100));}return document.getElementById('resp-body-body').textContent;})()
